items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I know Paul's barber rant. I know all of them.

ctx.x: After that you died, you know, yeah. Yeah, that's what he told me. I went to the

He liked to kick them out. 522 Burden Street. Yeah, you went and seen him. Yeah, a night before Mardi Gras, H.E. invited me to come down. And he wanted me to do a couple of numbers. But I didn't know that the M.G. of the Union was playing client at H.E. Yeah, look. H.E. said, Bob, he said, we sure would like for you to play a number. And old Paul did too. See, because I know Paul's barber rant. I know all of them. But they said, we don't know what he gonna say. Yeah, yeah. I said, well that's alright, man. I…
Cause just let's get right in. You ain't no lie, sure. Ain't nothing happening right now, first week.
